observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a PS4 game case for 'Red Dead Redemption II' (Rockstar Games) in front of a shop backdrop with 'PREZIN Gadgets' watermark.
No disc, no manual, no receipt, and no packaging interior is visible.
Case art and PS4 logo are legible; no PS5 branding is seen despite seller mentioning 'double plate' which could imply PS4/PS5 dual version, not shown.

claims.evidence: Only the case front is shown; disc surface and back cover not visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of the open case or disc to confirm seal or usage history.
This claim is irrelevant to a game disc (no ports or heat components); suggests a copy-pasted or mismatched description, a sign of a templated or careless listing.

claims.claim: Comes with original pads and UK receipt
claims.evidence: No receipt or pad (manual/inlay) shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Claims reference features (ports, overheating) that do not apply to a disc, indicating possible mismatched or copy-pasted ad text.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the actual disc and case interior matching the described claims.
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unreliable; price at worst case assuming only the case is confirmed, not the disc or accessories

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the disc surface or a video of it running on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/working unverified, same as base case-only item

risks.risk: Claimed 'UK receipt' and 'original pads' unproven, could inflate perceived value.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt and manual/pad included in the case.

proof_requests: Photo of the open case showing the actual disc and manual/pad.
Photo or video of the UK receipt mentioned.
Video of the disc running on a PS4 to confirm no read errors.
response.reason: The seller's claims of 'no overheating' and 'all ports working' do not apply to a game disc, indicating a mismatched or copy-pasted description that raises doubt about the listing's authenticity and the seller's attention to the actual item.
